verdict.meaning: PASS = no blocker: every frozen motion valid, nominal joint gates met, Monte Carlo p95 peak and mixed RMS within the gates, grasp, bus and regulator OK. Warnings (cost, voltage rating, runtime, unusable thermal model) do not flip it. 'robust' and 'benchmark mass' are the decision-rule checks (challenge-1): a PASS that is not robust is not a decision.

limitations: Open-loop reference replay: LIPM + analytic IK gait (no trajectory optimisation), so loads are a lower bound for a real balancing controller; stress walks bound some of the gap.
Torque demand includes the servo's reflected rotor inertia (BAM armature 0.0234 kg m^2), which dominates dynamic loads; that value is a 7.4 V identification used for all servos.
12 V STS3215 and STS3250 are datasheet-anchored with dynamics borrowed from the 7.4 V fit; the mid-speed torque curve is unverified (anchored vs pessimistic linear shown).
Printed structure mass is a pre-CAD guess; shells and brackets are not modelled. The benchmark fit is only a sanity bound / stress case.

Thermal: single lumped node, Rth/tau derived from one Robonine unit with assumed ambient; the model does not reproduce Robonine run 2, so thermal numbers are indicative and RMS <= rated is the thermal gate.
Latency, backlash and kp need the closed loop (P5); here they are sensitivities on one walk, never gates.
Leg-table / self-collision, cable routing and packaging are not checked (T-0004 floors are applied only as proportion minimums).
Stand-up from a fall is not modelled; the quasi-static sit-to-stand at 130 deg knee is a proxy only.

provenance.source: research/ai-engineering/RECOMMENDATIONS.md B4 ("p95 Monte Carlo peak <= 70% of measured stall at operating voltage")

a torque pulse shorter than ~0.1 s is absorbed by gear/foot compliance and costs the servo only a momentary tracking deficit, so the peak gate looks at the 100 ms moving average. A stiff ideal-PD replay shows 20-50 ms touchdown spikes (18 N.m at 1.5x speed) that no real servo-foot system transmits. 0.04 s would make touchdown spikes decide the verdict.
RECOMMENDATIONS.md B4 ("RMS <= continuous rating"); the rating is the vendor 'rated torque' (26-33% of stall), not a measured thermal limit
STS3215 Max_Temperature_Limit register default 70 C (research/actuators/feetech-sts3215/datasheet.yaml); Robonine saw an overheat flag at 70 C without active shutdown
